propositions: Gerrit Verify currently runs complete live-Pandoc corpus work taking 184+ seconds on macOS; implementation must reduce subprocess work while preserving all behavioral and contractual assertions
Committed deterministic Pandoc artifacts must cover every corpus-bound input across all settling passes, keyed by Pandoc 3.6.1 and binary SHA-256 values for Linux x86_64 and Darwin arm64

Static test converter backed by committed artifacts must drive production renderer through all corpus strata and assertions; retain one real product-path body per stratum plus compact version/platform/argv probes

Full-replay mode must exercise every corpus unit and settling pass through installed real Pandoc, executed by dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay job in external-integration.yml on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest
Fixture regeneration must be deterministic with non-writing validation path; mismatches in binary pin or platform fingerprint must fail before outputs are trusted
